recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes a build-scope inconsistency without changing the authoritative Resource-_list SearchParameter; any broader decision to re-open full URL or Type/id support for _list should be handled by a separate work-group issue.

additional_context: Resource is active build-scope source through fhir.ini. reconciliation: Changed source/search.html so the common-parameters summary table lists _list as special and describes resources referenced by a List resource or functional list, removing the stale string type and 'by id, not a full URL' qualifier.
